behavior.statement: Every case reached the record its terminal assertion names: twelve seeded rows and no other, the installation root committed to the address it claims, the task switch changed the URL and the body only, and the Studio resumed the draft at 40 percent without creating a second one. Both declared alternate paths reached a named terminal too.

ui.statement: The surface audit at step-49 measured this same head over ten entries: presentation, responsive and render-truth pass, accessibility and contrast fail into the design family, and taste is fix-first at a mean of 3.91 on two criteria the family owns. Nothing this run saw contradicts it.

entries.measured: All four cases reached their terminal assertion and both declared alternate paths reached theirs; every step after the entry address was chosen from a label on screen, including the sign-in form, and the run took 25.6s wide and 25.1s narrow against a 90s budget

Six committed steps, exactly the budget flow.md declares: sign in, open the collection, open the installed module, switch one task, take the exit back, open the draft. The run committed a seventh only because it deliberately signed in wrong first to test the correction, which is the run testing the flow rather than the flow costing a step

A wrong password kept the form, kept the email, left the password editable, and the message "That email or password is not right." rendered 52px below the password field rather than as a summary at the top; the correction was made at that field and the flow reached its terminal assertion one step later

The Sign in control changed within 0ms of the press, measured on the control itself; no step outlasted one second, so the progress and escape cases never fired, and no signal claimed settlement the store had not confirmed

The collection sits two levels from entry, inside the console band; the labels are the words the product uses (Modules, Custom modules, Installed solutions, Nivo solutions); the active navigation item, the heading and the address all read Modules

The refused installations read offers its own Try again, and the run took it and watched the section recover in place. The other refusal does not: a deep link to an installation the workspace does not own states "The server refused this installation or workspace identity." and offers no retry, no alternative and no contact anywhere in the region — the only way out is the surrounding console navigation. That is the module workspace this mission left unchanged, so it is a standing gap rather than a regression

Reloading Diagnostics returned Diagnostics selected with the same heading; pressing back returned Setup, the step before it, with no step re-committed; the address of every mid-flow step opened directly and resumed there

Email and Password carry persistent visible labels, not placeholders standing in for them; the rejection renders beside the password field and stays while it is corrected; Tab from Email lands on Password and Enter submits from the field; the fields declare autocomplete email and current-password with an email input mode

At 390x844 the step primary Create module sits at y=320 of an 844px frame — the upper half, not the lower half or a sticky bar the rule asks for. It is above the fold and needs no scrolling to reach, which is why this is a 3 and not lower, but a thumb reaches it across the frame

Create module carries the same verb and the same top-right position in the intro on both renders of the collection; every custom row action reads Resume interview or View module and every installed row action reads View details, one verb per consequence; the secondary pill shape is the same on every row

Headings are nouns and controls are verbs, progress carries its unit (40% complete) and no stub copy, lorem or untranslated key appears in the application copy. But on the English surface the four catalogue cards render Vietnamese descriptions — "Rà soát khoản phải trả, chứng từ và luồng duyệt tài chính." and three like it — which come from the catalogue read rather than from the locale catalogues, so an English reader meets copy in another language in the state this run reached
